# VinKand Technologies

> Software studio in Tamil Nadu, India. We build AI systems, AR experiences,
> mobile apps and high-scale web platforms for growing businesses.

## Services
- [Enterprise AI Architecture](https://vinkand.com/services/1): Deploying custom Large Language Models (LLMs) and predictive engines that integrate securely into your existing corporate infrastructure.
- [High-Scale Web Platforms](https://vinkand.com/services/2): Architecting resilient SaaS ecosystems designed to handle millions of concurrent requests with 99.99% uptime availability.
- [Intelligent Mobile Systems](https://vinkand.com/services/3): Native iOS and Android solutions featuring on-device machine learning, offline capability, and secure API middleware.
- [Immersive Spatial Computing](https://vinkand.com/services/4): Industrial-grade AR/VR training simulations and luxury retail experiences built for Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest.

- [The Rise of Edge AI: Processing at the Source](https://vinkand.com/blog/b3): Reducing latency and bandwidth costs by moving intelligence to the device.
- [VR Training: The New Industrial Standard](https://vinkand.com/blog/b4): Reducing risk and operational costs through immersive simulation training.
